definition: fraction of panel proteins in which a declared anchor is located
truth_source_or_none: the query's own residues, for A_DYAD only
identifiable: ESTABLISHABLE for A_DYAD; PARTIALLY for profile anchors
reason: MEASURED BASELINE ALREADY EXISTS: 94.9 percent dyad occupancy across 2,202 proteins, with per-family rates from 52.0 to 100. A profile anchor's recovery is model-dependent and is mapping confidence, not homology support
allowable_claim: anchor recovery rate per family, with the anchor named
prohibited_phrasing: must not be called detection accuracy
denominator: proteins of that family in the panel

definition: fraction of proteins whose located anchors occur in the reference order
reason: computable without external truth, but a decoder or a profile scan can ENFORCE order. Identifiable only for methods demonstrated capable of emitting disorder, and that capacity must be shown first
allowable_claim: ordered-anchor rate, for methods able to violate order
prohibited_phrasing: the word recovery is prohibited where order is enforced by construction
denominator: proteins with at least two anchors located

definition: agreement of anchor coordinates across reference-panel resamples, alignment methods and profile parameters
reason: fully defined. The ensemble must vary PANEL COMPOSITION, not only algorithm parameters - the omission that broke the previous round
prohibited_phrasing: must not be called a confidence interval on a biological boundary

definition: agreement of the homologous-core column assignment across alignment methods
reason: a direct comparison. Columns that move between methods are not homologous columns, they are method artefacts
allowable_claim: per-column stability, with unstable columns masked and reported
prohibited_phrasing: an MSA emitting a column is not evidence of homology

definition: mapping success on panel members held out of derivation
reason: a rate with a declared denominator
prohibited_phrasing: must not be called accuracy or validation

definition: V05 stratified by best identity to the derivation panel
reason: identity distance and family novelty are separate axes and are reported jointly in a two-way table
allowable_claim: callability by identity bin and family status
prohibited_phrasing: must not conflate distance with novelty

quantity: transfer across withheld families and classes
definition: V05 with whole families or whole lineages withheld
reason: THE CAPABILITY THIS REDESIGN BUYS. A 38-label, 6-lineage panel can withhold a whole family or a whole lineage; the 66-protein single-class historical substrate could not withhold anything, which is why class transfer was untestable in principle in both failed rounds
prohibited_phrasing: a successful mapping is not a correct mapping; must not be called accuracy

definition: whether a sequence anchor occupies a homologous structural position
truth_source_or_none: structural feature assignment, a different representation
reason: post-freeze only. Bounded by coverage: 21 of 38 families have no structure, prior cross-validation covers 11 of 25 with thumb Jaccard 0.0 for five, LtrA/5G2X is excluded as the historical coordinate carrier, and construct offsets are unresolved
allowable_claim: structural correspondence per structure, for represented families only
prohibited_phrasing: must not be called independent validation of the coordinate system

definition: agreement of the frozen coordinates when the panel is rebuilt under a different admissible allocation
reason: directly tests the design choice this task could not settle - whether UG is one lineage or 29. Rebuild under UG_OPTION_A and UG_OPTION_B and measure whether the frame moves

definition: agreement across Strategy A, B and D outputs converted to a common coordinate representation
reason: requires a predeclared common output conversion, which must exist before any method is run
prohibited_phrasing: methods disagreeing is a finding, not a failure

quantity: homologous N-terminal feature corresponding to historical RT0
definition: whether an RT0-corresponding feature exists and transfers
identifiable: UNESTABLISHED as a biological claim; the SEQUENCE SPACE is now observable
reason: full-length-first makes the region inspectable for the first time - median 97 aa N-terminal of the RVT_1 window, 62 percent of proteins carrying at least 80 aa. But establishing RT0 needs a non-LTR comparison class, and there are ZERO local non-LTR structures and no registered non-LTR sequence set
allowable_claim: the N-terminal extension length distribution by family, which IS measurable; and whether any conserved feature is detectable there
prohibited_phrasing: no RT0 occupancy, presence or absence
denominator: proteins with a mapped RVT_1 window

quantity: biological presence or absence of a feature in a class
definition: the claim that a class genuinely lacks a feature
reason: unchanged across three reviews. Positive performance in another class does not establish sensitivity in a divergent class; intact flanks do not prove the interior is recognisable; perturbation-stable failure can be stable model bias; and two profile instruments sharing Pfam or myRT ancestry are not independent
prohibited_phrasing: absent, lost, lacks and missing are prohibited. Use NOT_CALLED_ON_COMPLETE_SEQUENCE rather than NOT_DETECTED_INSPECTABLE, which implies demonstrated class-specific sensitivity
denominator: inspectable full-length proteins of that class

definition: true start and end of a conserved region
reason: unchanged and not reopened. BOUNDARY_ACCURACY and BOUNDARY_CALIBRATION remain UNESTABLISHED
prohibited_phrasing: no substitute metric may be renamed accuracy

definition: whether the instrument assigns the correct RT family
reason: Stage-1's 42 labels are the myRT system's own output under a documented collapse - 38 one-to-one, 7 fine-to-coarse, 1 rename. Testing a myRT-derived instrument against them is the same instrument twice
prohibited_phrasing: no family assignment accuracy, precision or recall

definition: fitness of the extracted core for Stage 06
reason: requires homologous-column coverage, order, ambiguity bounds, insertion masking, truncation status and exclusion of non-homologous lineage-specific regions - each a separate measurement Stage 2 does not make
allowable_claim: candidate core substrate with per-sequence coverage and ambiguity fields, so Stage 06 applies its own criteria

quantity: three quantities are kept distinct and never substituted
definition: homology support - is the feature really homologous; mapping confidence - did the instrument place it; biological presence - is it really there
reason: the previous rounds failed partly by letting the second stand in for the first and third
allowable_claim: each claim names which of the three it is
